title: Crypto misuse: CBC/HMAC sess_reset error paths return with key_bytes live in ctx
description: wolfssl_aes_cbc_sess_reset and wolfssl_hmac_sess_reset error paths leave key_bytes (raw AES/HMAC key) in ctx without immediate zeroization. ioctl_reset sets error=true, preventing further use. sess_free eventually calls memzero_explicit(ctx) at close, so key IS wiped before deallocation. But FIPS 140-3 requires zeroization when no longer needed — a dead-session key should be wiped at reset-error time, not deferred to close. Fix: add memzero_explicit(ctx->key_bytes, sizeof(ctx->key_bytes)) on each error-return path in sess_reset for both CBC and HMAC providers.
